usedFor: Cakemail holds campaigns and contacts, and Anthropic Claude writes a response when “New Campaign” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Campaign” in Cakemail, then “Generate Response” in Anthropic Claude
bestTemplate.why: A fresh campaign is the right moment to hand its details to the model and get a response back.

watchOut: “Contact Updated” and “Campaign Updated” fire on every change, so “Generate Response” can run twice for one record.
